verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D is a desktop CPU, not a software service or platform. Versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy are not something buyers compare across CPUs, so this story is a category error for this product type. The evidence only shows hardware features and tuning utilities (Ryzen Master, PBO, EXPO), plus a bare link to Ryzen AI Software with no mention of API versioning, so the axis does not flip to applicable.
